requirements.summary: Production graph must never catch-and-continue a failed node build.
Endpoint count must not silently change topology strategy to urltest.
Global Auto must use semantic selectable roots rather than indiscriminate leaves/helpers.
Detours must resolve after all nodes are tagged so forward references work.
Missing detour targets are connection-critical and must fail explicitly.
Graph identity must be independent of display names; duplicate remarks must not overwrite references.
Production graph must support top-level Core endpoints[] in addition to outbounds[].
Migrate first, then validate the exact final JSON returned/launched.
PacketTunnel startup must not use try? migration fallback to unchecked raw config.
Connection-critical arrays, objects, booleans and numbers must not be flattened to String.
Semantic equality/fingerprint must include runtime connection semantics and exclude provenance-only source text.
Migrate production writers away from prebuilt NormalizedNode.outbound and remove early-return validation bypass.
Pinned Core WireGuard must use exact endpoint schema, not removed legacy outbound schema.
Preserve every peer and peer-specific AllowedIPs/PSK/keepalive/endpoint fields.
Preserve all AWG2/AWG3.x fields supported by the pinned donor without flattening/loss.
Do not infer AWG versions from guessed field boundaries; use authoritative export/source semantics.
Battle/tests must use the same production WG/AWG graph path; remove test-only endpoint rewriting.
Builder must emit from canonical normalized state, not reparse node.source at runtime.
Model and validate standard MASQUE separately from Cloudflare/WARP; do not default arbitrary missing profile to cloudflare.
Do not silently turn a lost/unknown Mieru transport into TCP unless the exact schema proves an authoritative default.
Do not invent root as missing SSH username unless exact upstream schema defines it.
Emit XHTTP numeric/structured fields using exact pinned JSON types; extra must not be stringified JSON.
Explicit unsupported/unknown transport must not disappear into protocol default transport.
Map Remnawave, 3x-ui, x-ui, tx-ui, Marzban, Marzneshin, PasarGuard, Hiddify, Libertea, s-ui, wg-easy and Amnezia source semantics with source-derived fixtures.
Use structural JSON/YAML/config detection; support Xray object+array and re-detect decoded base64 JSON/YAML without requiring share schemes.
Unknown subscription hosts must not receive stable HWID/device identity on the first request.
Redirect security must compare normalized origin and strip sensitive auth/identity headers; reject HTTPS downgrade by default.
Enforce response size while streaming rather than only after URLSession has materialized the full body.
Preserve bounded safe 4xx/451 body+headers+final URL for panel error classification.
Keychain HWID updates must not delete a valid identity before replacement succeeds; failures cannot silently rotate identity.
Prepare/build must prove exact SING_BOX_REV base before applying overlays.
Verify every mandatory XHTTP/AWG/MASQUE/Mieru/encryption capability overlay, not only Mieru.
Release prepare must fail if dependencies are missing rather than mutating go.mod via go get.
A build invocation may only consume the Libbox artifact produced by that invocation; stale root frameworks cannot be candidates.
Validate every requested platform/device/simulator slice and expected architecture independently.
Enforce documented Go/gomobile versions/policy and remove unconditional gomobile-init error suppression.
Every supported source field must have parser→normalized→builder→exact JSON→test traceability.
Battle/golden tests must call the exact production graph path and actual built capabilities.
Build iOS host and Packet Tunnel Extension after Core/Libbox remediation.
If paired/signing environment exists, install, launch and start PacketTunnel on a physical iPhone with safe logs.
After the final code change, re-audit final HEAD and fix every newly found code-completable logic break.
